items.title: Kafka Connect
items.description: **Kafka Connect** is a framework for **reliably moving data between Kafka and external systems** (databases, file systems, cloud services) without writing.

items.title: Kafka Connect — Single Message Transforms (SMTs)
items.description: Lightweight per-record transformations in Kafka Connect. Covers built-in SMTs, conditional predicates, custom SMT development, and when to use SMTs vs stream processing frameworks.

items.title: Preventing Kafka Connect Rebalance Storms
items.description: Deep-dive into Kafka Connect rebalance storm internals — why they happen, the two rebalance protocols, incremental cooperative mechanics, task assignment algorithms, Spring Boot monitoring, and a production-grade rolling restart runbook.
